**Finding resubmitted: compliant** — no redline, no counterparty comment.

What changed in the repair:
- **Verified absence document-wide.** Beyond the planner's two candidate sections, I pulled the full section outline and ran searches for *solicit, employ or engage, induce, recruit, hire, employee, personnel*. There is no non-solicitation, no-poach or no-hire covenant binding Meridian Fieldworks anywhere in the Agreement.
- **Addressed the two failed deterministic checks explicitly.** The duration and general-solicitation-carve-out regexes look for a restriction period and an exception sentence *inside* a covenant. With no covenant present, they have nothing to measure, so their failure is non-probative. § 12.3's general-recruitment language is in substance stronger than the fallback carve-out, since it is a standing freedom rather than an exception carved out of a restriction.
- **Quote widened** to the full § 12.3 text so the preserved hiring right, not just the no-hire disclaimer, is on the face of the finding.

Status remains compliant at the **preferred** position ("no non-solicit on Customer"), and § 12.3 benefits us, so it is not flagged. The 24-month non-compete in § 12.4 is again noted only as context — it is a separate restrictive covenant for the non-compete rule and is not double-flagged here.
